description: Website-side expected results that supersede five cases in the v2.1 research file dose_test_cases.json after the 2026-11-13 renal and hepatic safety corrections. The research file itself is unchanged for traceability. All other research cases keep their original expected results.

supersedes.was: dose 3.5 mg (range 3.5-5.0) via R1 x0.50-0.75 at eGFR 45
supersedes.reason: R1 removed: only source is a secondary table (Aronoff 1999) for GFR 10-50; the morphine label gives no number ("lower than normal dosage"). Clinician review.

supersedes.was: dose 7.5 mg (range 7.5-22.5) via R1 at eGFR 40
dose 2.5 mg (range 2.5-7.5) via H3 x1/3-1/2, severe hepatic
supersedes.reason: H3 removed: the 1/3-1/2 fraction is from the extended-release oxycodone label; the immediate-release label says only "lower than usual dosage". Clinician review.

supersedes.was: 50 mg every 12 h, max 100 mg/day via TO4, mild/moderate hepatic
supersedes.reason: The tramadol label (Ultram 02/2023) gives 50 mg every 12 h for severe hepatic impairment only; applying it to mild/moderate was an unapproved extrapolation (D17). Clinician review (TO4M). TO4 still applies to severe.

supersedes.was: dose 6.5 mg with maintenance interval x2 via H1, severe hepatic
supersedes.reason: H1 removed: interval doubling is from a secondary table only; the morphine label says "lower than normal dosage" with no number. Clinician review.
